name: Endlessh
tagline: An SSH tarpit that very slowly sends an endless, random SSH banner. It keeps SSH clients locked up for hours or even days at a time. The purpose is to put your real SSH server on another port and then let the script kiddies get stuck in this tarpit instead of bothering a real server.
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/endlessh:version-dfe44eb2@sha256:1ba907783c782f2900347a42d730d97ccc88ab50e9c3403657211ca711d02ecc
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      MSDELAY: ''
      MAXLINES: ''
      MAXCLIENTS: ''
      LOGFILE: ''
      BINDFAMILY: ''
    ports:
      - target: 22
        published: 2222
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
